title: This project builds the portable claude-settings backlog as PRs
why: Your idea, Oct 26: the goal of the advisor setup was something that answers your questions and pushes the backlog along; this cloud project can edit code.
note:
State, Oct 26, checked at claude-settings bf084dfd. This project builds claude-settings in cloud threads; CI proves each PR on ubuntu, macos and windows. Cloud containers install no hooks or agents, so a fresh reviewer and CI gate each logic diff. merge.py cannot run from the cloud until c53 lands (GraphQL blocked). Integration branch batch-oct26 (from main bf084dfd): green lanes join it with plain git once reviewed; CI runs on it by workflow_dispatch. In: #583 (c43 debt), #580 (c29), #578 (c51), #582 (c45), #581 (c58). To join as each goes green: #584 (c50), c57, c46 lane 1, c47 part 1, c44, c53. You merge the one integration PR with merge.py on the Mac, which lands c53 and every lane at once; lane PRs then close as replaced. Later batches merge from the cloud. The build advisor dispatches 4 to 6 or more build threads; triage sets the order (c55). Placed ahead of all build steps (triage, Oct 26): it is the frame the batches run in.
